test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The activity of writing dictionaries
solution:
The correct answer is '**Lexicography**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **most appropriate** one-wor substitute for '**The activity of writing dictionaries**' is '**Lexicography**'.
 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• ​**Biography**- an account of someone's life written by someone else.
 
• **Bibliography**- a list of the books referred to in a scholarly work, typically printed as an appendix.
 
• **Theology**- the study of the nature of God and religious belief.
